lisette.style: Time your draws and pin enemies to walls from range.

kit.name: Drawstring
kit.line: Hold to draw, release to shoot. Release on the flash to draw faster.

kit.name: Red Thread
kit.line: See enemies under half health through cover.

kit.name: Slip Stitch
kit.line: Roll, then walk through rocks and trees for 2.8s.

kit.name: Pin Down
kit.line: Fire a heavy arrow that knocks back. Stuns enemies it drives into a wall.

kit.name: Hemline
kit.line: Rain arrows in an arc. They slow and cut healing.

kit.name: Finishing Touch
kit.line: Fire 3 piercing arrows with no draw.

cinder.style: Get close and keep fire on enemies until they burn.

kit.name: Open Flame
kit.line: Hold to spray fire 6m ahead.

kit.name: Boiling Point
kit.line: Keep fire on an enemy and they catch fire.

kit.name: Lock Horns
kit.line: Ram into the first enemy and shove them back. 2 charges.

kit.name: Spitfire
kit.line: Shoot a cinder that slows and sets an enemy on fire.

kit.name: Molten Hug
kit.line: Pull nearby enemies in. Gain a shield if you hit any.

kit.name: Red Carpet
kit.line: Fly forward and leave a lava trail that burns and slows.

breaker.style: Block with your shield and knock enemies into walls.

kit.name: Capstan Hammer
kit.line: Tap to throw your hammer, tap again to call it back. Hold to charge a slam.

kit.name: Hold Fast
kit.line: Knock an enemy into a wall or another enemy to stun them.

kit.name: Tideturner
kit.line: Dash and spin your hammer around you.

kit.name: Blue Guard
kit.line: Hold to raise your shield and block shots from the front.

kit.name: Safe Harbour
kit.line: Heal allies around your hammer for 4s.

kit.name: Groundswell
kit.line: Slam the ground and launch enemies in a 16m lane.

tarek.style: Raise rocks for cover, then punch them at enemies.

kit.name: Stone's Throw
kit.line: Tap to throw a boulder. Hold to punch enemies back and launch your rocks.

kit.name: Jade Ward
kit.line: Punch your rocks to gain a shield. Stacks 4 times.

kit.name: Leap of Faith
kit.line: Hop toward the cursor, up to 3 times.

kit.name: Rock Bottom
kit.line: Slam the ground ahead. Stuns enemies at the centre.

kit.name: Foothold
kit.line: Raise 3 rocks that block shots. Climb them or punch them.

kit.name: Backbone
kit.line: Raise a 21m ridge of rocks. It can bridge the abyss.

grimble.style: Pull an enemy to you and finish them up close.

kit.name: Potshot
kit.line: Fire 7 slugs in a tight group. Hits from behind deal 50% more.

kit.name: Finders Keepers
kit.line: Gain 2.5% health per knock or assist, up to 10 times.

kit.name: Mad Dash
kit.line: Lunge a short way. 3 charges.

kit.name: Sticky Fingers
kit.line: Reach through rocks, grab the first enemy and pull them to you, stunned.

kit.name: Lump Sum
kit.line: Slam your fist down and stun enemies in front for 1.1s.

kit.name: Both Barrels
kit.line: Charge up, then fire 2 waves of slugs that block healing.

vex.style: Daze an enemy with Coin Blast, then shoot them while it lasts.

kit.name: Brass Tacks
kit.line: Fire a full-auto rifle. Dazed enemies take 76% more.

kit.name: Hot Streak
kit.line: Knock down a Hunter to get Slipstep back.

kit.name: Slipstep
kit.line: Tap to skid, hold to slide. You can shoot the whole time.

kit.name: Coin Blast
kit.line: Fire a charge that Dazes the first enemy it hits.

kit.name: Palm Spear
kit.line: Stand still to charge, then fire a beam through walls.

kit.name: Penny Drop
kit.line: Drop a shell on the cursor after 1.6s. The ground burns for 3s.

kael.style: Stay close and finish hurt enemies.

kit.name: Bitter End
kit.line: Swing wide slashes. Hold to throw a ranged wave.

kit.name: Bad Blood
kit.line: Deal damage to fill Rage. At full, deal 15% more for 6s.

kit.name: Rampage
kit.line: Dash through enemies. The end hits twice as hard. 2 charges.

kit.name: Final Swing
kit.line: Tap to slam a lane ahead. Hold to lunge at the first enemy.

kit.name: Short Leash
kit.line: Hook an enemy or wall. Press again to pull yourself in.

kit.name: Blow for Blow
kit.line: Block all damage for 0.65s, then cleave and heal from the hit.

ryzz.style: Stack 4 Static on one enemy, then Wirerun through them.

kit.name: Finger Guns
kit.line: Shoot bolts from your fingers. Each hit adds 1 Static.

kit.name: Live Wire
kit.line: Wirerun through an enemy with 4 Static for a big hit and a reset.

kit.name: Wirerun
kit.line: Hold to aim a lane, release to dash down it as lightning.

kit.name: Pink Spear
kit.line: Throw a rod that knocks enemies back. Stuns them against walls.

kit.name: Undercurrent
kit.line: Mark a circle. Lightning strikes it and drags enemies toward or away from you.

kit.name: Stormfall
kit.line: Jump up, then strike down at the cursor and knock enemies back.

motley.style: Stun from range, then swap places to set up your bomb.

kit.name: Comic Timing
kit.line: Shoot orbs through walls. Wait between shots for a bigger one.

kit.name: Swell
kit.line: Deal damage to fill Swell. At full, your abilities get stronger for 9s.

kit.name: Musical Chairs
kit.line: Throw a lantern and swap places with everyone near it.

kit.name: Stage Fright
kit.line: Fire shards that stun the first enemy hit. Longer flight, longer stun.

kit.name: Gag Gift
kit.line: Drop a bomb that grows for 6.5s. Press again to pop it.

kit.name: Main Attraction
kit.line: Open a well that stuns enemies and pulls them in for 3.5s.

claire.style: Slow enemies with ice and block them off with your wall.

kit.name: Ice Darts
kit.line: Hold to fire darts that curve toward the enemy nearest your cursor.

kit.name: Cold Snap
kit.line: Hit an enemy with 8 darts to Shatter them for area damage.

kit.name: Free Skate
kit.line: Hold to skate. Your darts hit twice as hard while skating.

kit.name: Icebreaker
kit.line: Throw a spear that slows an area, then bursts after 1.8s.

kit.name: Cold Front
kit.line: Slide an ice wall that blocks shots. Press again to stop it.

kit.name: Freeze Frame
kit.line: Freeze yourself and take no damage. After 3.3s, stun enemies around you.

pip.style: Heal your team and carry downed teammates to safety.

kit.name: Hot and Cold
kit.line: Throw embers. Each hit stacks Kindle for more ember damage, up to 5.

kit.name: Carry the Day
kit.line: Run into a downed teammate to carry them. Carry up to 2.

kit.name: Foxtrot
kit.line: Hop a short way. In the air, glide about 10m.

kit.name: Stick Around
kit.line: Stick a seed on an enemy. If they stay near you for 2s, it roots them.

kit.name: Hearthlight
kit.line: Heal teammates in a ring around you. Press again to throw it.

kit.name: Rise and Shine
kit.line: Tether a teammate and heal them for 5s. Revives them if downed.

sable.style: Stick to one enemy and stack Marks on them.

kit.name: Sleight Trigger
kit.line: Throw bolts from each hand. They land at your cursor.

kit.name: Marks
kit.line: Each hit on an enemy adds a Mark. Marks add damage to your shots.

kit.name: Vault
kit.line: Cartwheel. Your next shot deals 2.3x and refunds Vault if it hits.

kit.name: Dark Bola
kit.line: Throw a bola that slows the first enemy. Catch a second to stun both.

kit.name: White Flash
kit.line: Throw a dagger. Press again to blink to it.

kit.name: Last Dance
kit.line: Throw blades at every enemy within 5m for 2s.

gill.style: Fence up close and throw vials to stun enemies.

kit.name: Swordfish
kit.line: Thrust twice, then lunge. The lunge slows.

kit.name: Fish Out of Water
kit.line: Hit an enemy with 3 different vial effects in 5s to stun them.

kit.name: Deep End
kit.line: Swim 6m underground. Surface near enemies to knock them up.

kit.name: Grab Bag
kit.line: Throw the next vial from your bag. Each vial has a different effect.

kit.name: Spin Cycle
kit.line: Spin to hit nearby enemies, then send a waterspout that knocks them up.

kit.name: Surf's Up
kit.line: Surf a wave 14m. It knocks up and slows enemies it hits.
